full_prompt_en: A square hand-colored chronicle-style print surveys a sprawling walled city from elevated ground, with a dense forest of rooftops and towers under a pale lined sky. The upper band is warm parchment white, crossed by closely spaced gray horizontal strokes that describe a low cloud layer. A small rounded cloud sits to the left of the highest spires. Near the upper center, a large cluster of tall churchlike towers rises above the rest of the city. Narrow pointed roofs, pale walls, and dark window marks distinguish the peaks from the many smaller steeples on the horizon. Beneath them, terraces and walls step down through overlapping blocks of gray-green masonry. In the middle distance, another fortified complex with a square gate tower and adjoining wall sits above the crowded lower town. The central gateway appears as a dark arch framed by pale stone. Around it, small steep roofs in ochre, brown, and slate gray pack tightly together, their edges drawn in fine ink lines. At the lower left and lower center, tiny figures and clustered marks imply a busy route outside the wall, while irregular green patches and a few trees break up the built surfaces. Along the lower right, a curving pale road or wall line guides the eye through the crowd of marks toward the city's center. The perspective is elevated and panoramic rather than mathematically precise; distant towers remain visible despite the immense density below. Light is diffuse and nearly shadowless, as if the entire scene were laid out for inspection on a page. The image gains volume from fine hatching, small dark window recesses, and overlapping silhouettes, not from dramatic cast shadows. Muted teal, moss green, dusty ochre, and brown tint the predominantly black-and-cream engraving. The overall composition is crowded yet legible, using repeated vertical spires and stepped layers to turn an enormous city into a textured historical panorama.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形手工设色编年史风格版画从高处俯瞰广阔的城墙都市，密集的屋顶和塔楼伸向浅色线纹天空。上方是一道暖羊皮纸白色区域，紧密排列的灰色横线描绘低低的云层。最高尖塔左侧有一小团圆云。上部中央附近，一组巨大的教堂般高塔在城市其余部分上方升起。狭窄尖顶、浅色墙面和深色窗痕使这些高处与地平线上许多较小尖塔区分开来。其下，台地与城墙经过层层重叠的灰绿砌石块向下递落。中景处，另一组带方形门塔和相连城墙的防御建筑位于拥挤的下城上方。中央城门是一道由浅色石材框住的深拱。周围，赭黄、棕色与石板灰的小陡坡屋顶紧密挤在一起，边缘由细墨线描绘。左下和下方中央，细小人物与聚集的记号暗示城墙外繁忙道路，不规则绿地和少数树木打断建筑表面。沿右下方，一道弯曲的浅色道路或墙线引导目光穿过密集痕迹，进入城市中央。视角高而全景化，却并非数学上完全精确；尽管下方极其密集，远处塔楼仍然可见。光线漫射且几乎没有投影，仿佛整座城市被铺在页面上供人检视。图像的体积来自细排线、小小的深色窗洞和互相遮挡的剪影，而非戏剧性投影。低饱和青蓝、苔绿、灰赭黄和棕色为以黑线和奶油色为主的版画着色。整体构图拥挤却易读，以重复竖向尖塔和台阶般层叠的区域，把庞大都市化为富肌理的历史全景。
style_prompt_en: The hand-colored print relies on intricate ink outlines, dense hatching, and subdued pigment laid over parchment cream. Many small units overlap in shallow panoramic layers, with a few taller vertical accents rising above a broad field of fine marks. Black line work defines edges and recesses; muted teal, moss green, dusty ochre, and brown sit as thin, slightly uneven color washes. Repeated rooftops, windows, and stepped walls create a compressed rhythm without requiring exact modern perspective. Distant forms become paler and finer but remain unusually legible, emphasizing an inventory-like view of an entire setting. Soft, nearly shadowless illumination keeps detail available across the frame, while small dark openings and line density supply local depth. Horizontal strokes in open areas counter the vertical pattern of the crowded center. The overall effect is archival and expansive, with meticulous miniature detail held together by broad tonal bands and aged-paper warmth.
style_prompt_zh: 这种手工设色版画依赖精细墨线轮廓、密集排线以及铺在羊皮纸奶油色之上的低饱和颜料。许多细小单元在浅层全景中互相遮挡，少数较高的竖向重音从宽阔细痕色域中升起。黑色线条定义边缘和凹处，低饱和青蓝、苔绿、灰赭黄与棕色以薄而略不均匀的色洗铺上。重复的斜面、开口和台阶状边界形成压缩节奏，不要求精确的现代透视。远处形体变淡变细，却仍异常清晰，强调对整片场域进行清点般的视角。柔和、几乎无影的光线让细节遍及画框，小小暗洞与线条密度提供局部纵深。开放区域的横向笔痕对照拥挤中央的竖向纹样。整体效果有档案感且广阔，精密的微型细节被宽阔的明度色带和旧纸暖意维系。
theme_en: A sprawling walled city with clustered towers in a hand-colored chronicle print
theme_zh: 手工设色编年史版画中，塔楼密集的广阔城墙都市
name: Nuremberg Chronicle
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
